checks.rule: Every Plex copy whose file the server can see is matched to exactly one item on that server, and no item is matched twice (two Plex copies of one file share its item, and say so). A match where both sides have a file names the same file. A server that hides its paths gives no file to check, so this check can't pass for it. Jellyfin ↔ Navidrome: no item matched twice.
Every copy and item is matched or unmatched, never both; every unmatched one has one known reason; the reasons add up to the unmatched count.

Every case (the first copy or item of each tier, note and reason on each pair) plus 20 copies at random, each asked of the server by ID now (GET only): the item is there, its file is the Plex copy's and its duration within 2 s of Plex's (jimbo-dj's last Plex sync).
